title: Review and submit
serverRules: These are preliminary checks. The server performs the final validation.

checks.name: Name is provided and contains 2 to 120 characters
checks.city: City is provided, at most 80 characters
checks.address: Address is provided, at most 200 characters
checks.elements: The floor plan contains at least one element
checks.planFormat: The floor plan format and elements are valid
checks.zones: At least one valid zone is saved
checks.zoneElements: Every zone contains at least one element
checks.unique: No element is assigned more than once

awaiting: The request is awaiting the owner's decision
confirmBody: The request will be sent to the Apex owner. Editing will be locked until the owner makes a decision.
production: This operation runs in production and will submit a real request.
noRepeat: After confirming, wait for the result. Repeated clicks will be blocked.
sending: Submitting and checking the result… Do not submit again.
submitted: The request was sent to the owner. Editing is locked until their decision.
changed: The request was reloaded. Submission by this operation is not confirmed. Review the current data and status before continuing.
unsavedBody: Check the request status before leaving this page.

errors.revision_conflict: The data changed. Review the latest request before submitting again.
errors.invalid_store: Check the store details in the first step.
errors.invalid_plan: The floor plan is missing or invalid. Check the second step.
errors.invalid_zones: Check the zones in the third step.
errors.invalid_assignments: Check element assignments in the third step.
errors.invalid_status: The request status changed. Its current state has been loaded.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this operation.
errors.not_authenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.owner_not_configured: The Apex owner is not configured. Submission is unavailable.
errors.unknown: The submission result could not be confirmed. Check the request status first.
errors.invalid_response: The server returned an unconfirmed result. Check the request status.
errors.unresolved: The submission result could not be confirmed and the request could not be reloaded. Resubmission is blocked until its state is checked.
errors.storage: The request could not be processed.
errors.plan_too_large: The floor plan exceeds the size limit.
errors.too_many_elements: The floor plan contains too many elements.
errors.duplicate_element: The floor plan contains duplicate element IDs.
